payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate downward from y to p+1 over odd numbers; for each candidate, test if it has any divisor in [2,p] using trial division up to sqrt(n) capped at p. Return first such number or -1.
payload.rationale: The solution performs a linear search over odd candidates, testing the unreachable condition via divisor check. It is a complete search but lacks branching, bounding, or backtracking typical of the subtypes. The closest label is branch-and-bound due to suggested rule, but it does not actually employ branch-and-bound.
